content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository MiSTer-devel_MegaDrive_MiSTer_pr58, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# Incorrect button mapping for Master System games
Using a Mega Drive controller to play Master System games on either Mega Drive or Master System hardware, the Master System buttons 1 and 2 map to Mega Drive B and C respectively.
This is also handled correctly by the core using controllers via SNAC.
However, MiSTer mapped controllers configured for the Mega Drive core use A for 1, and B for 2, rather than B and C.
This can of course be worked around by remapping a Mega Drive style modern controller every time you go between Mega Drive and Master System games if the original inputs are sought, but corrected mapping would be convenient.
Many thanks
Here are the skeletons of the files:

Please review the issue description and thoroughly analyze the issue to uncover all possible causes.
Then, review the skeletons of potentially relevant files and identify up to FOUR files that are most likely to require edits to resolve the issue.

IMPORTANT:
1. Select files ONLY FROM THE PROVIDED FILE LIST and specify their FULL PATHS.
2. The returned files should be separated by new lines ordered by most to least important. Wrap the file list in triple backticks (```).

Explain your reasoning, then provide your answer in the following format:
```
full_path1/file1.py
full_path2/file2.py
```

Based on how button‐to‐signal mapping is done in the MD core’s ARM code, the mapping for SMS buttons when running in the MD core will live in the controller I/O module and the generic input parser.  You’ll need to fix the SMS-mode button-1/2 to Mega-Drive B/C remapping in those files:

```  
software/controller.c
software/controller.h
software/input.c
software/input.h
```
